title: Jade combat implementation audit handoff
purpose: Describe current implementation, not certify game correctness. Review against normal datamine plus explicit user-confirmed mechanics. No combat data changed by this report.

scope.mysticScope: All records in data/skill/mystic.json are included to cover shared fillers and their triggered helpers, not just current preset selections.
scope.excluded: Skills absent from runtime are not invented. Candidate unmapped export IDs are listed separately. No independent numerical implementation or global damage boost is introduced.
scope.sourcePrecedence: Current JSON and runtime trace describe implementation. Datamine establishes external evidence; user-confirmed mechanics may intentionally override ambiguous exports. Older prose is historical.

formula.baseline: BasePhysical = phyCoef × (outcomePhysicalAttack − adjustedEnemyDefense) + phyBonus × (1 + eligibleFlatAttackBonus). BaseAttribute[channel] = attrCoef × outcomeAttributeAttack[channel] + primaryPathOnly(attrBonus × (1 + eligibleFlatAttackBonus)). Honor any coefficient modifiers before these expressions.
formula.channels: Physical clamps to zero after multiplication. Physical and each of four attribute channels use their own penetration/resistance and channel-damage multiplier. Primary Silkbind path multiplier is 1.5; other attribute paths use 1.
formula.shared: action.damageScale (default 1) × (1 + sum(baseDMGBonus)) × (1 + sum(Category1)) × (1 + sum(matchingAttunementDMGBonus)); then channel-specific mechanism multiplier and outcome multiplier. Category1 sums eligible gear bonuses, dmgBonus and hpDMGBonus; it is not a product of each named buff. Attribute channels add attributeDMGBonus inside their Category1 bracket. Physical/attribute channel stat damage bonuses multiply separately. physicalAttackBonus modifies the effective attack range, not final damage.
formula.outcomes: Expected damage weights Abrasion/Normal/Critical/Affinity using shared effective rates. Critical multiplier clamp(1 + effectiveCritDmgBonus + activeCritDmgBonus,1.35,2.50); Affinity clamp(...,1.20,2.30). Simulation samples outcomes and attack ranges; expected/sampled must share mechanics.
formula.mechanism: 1 + globalDmgBonus + globalHPDMGBonus; Bellstrike additionally includes globalBellstrikeDMGBonus. Exhausted currently uses +0.1 globalDmgBonus. It is not an additive Category1 bonus.
formula.attunement: All top-level effect.tags must match; each nested array is OR. Excluded tags must not match. One definition contributes once even if multiple OR alternatives match. Amounts come from equipped gear, not the multiplier 1 in the definition.
formula.time: Action times are relative to owning cast/component start; source actions can outlive cast completion. Damage resolves in event order using hit-time state and explicit snapshot rules. Array order resolves ties. BattleEnd excludes hits at its timestamp. Skill grouping changes reporting only.
formula.statPipeline: Use shared characterComposition/characterStats/rotationCalculationBundle, not sums of displayed numbers. InnerWay bySoloLevel tables use solo level; martialArt talent[rank] is a complete rank, not sum of ranks. BT17/18/19 use martial rank13/14/15. Raw-stat-derived conversions and effective attack/outcome calculations remain in the shared pipeline.

mechanics.name: Unfading Flower
mechanics.implementation: Activation normal 1.093s or cancel 0.6s; initial heavy at 0.5963992753846155s, mode at 0.6s. The heavy is Special-tagged in current data, not Heavy-tagged despite its reporting category, and has no FrequentProjectile tag. Requires >=50 Blossoms and inactive UF. Mode blocks ordered Umbrella skills, not triggered projectiles. Starts from 100 in presets. Base drain 10/s; LB adds 10/s; Airborne adds 15/s instead. No passive 0.3/s regen in mode. Depletion ends mode immediately; 15 Blossoms return after 0.2s. Volley first +0.55s after mode, interval 0.5s. Each projectile is Cp=Ca=0.51082875, Bp=141.375, Ba=77, plus 15% PvE HP damage; LB gives 2 hits and Airborne 3.

mechanics.name: Spring Sorrow
mechanics.implementation: Two base charges; Blossom Barrage T0 allows three; recharge sequentially at 15s. T3 selects faster Barrage component. One damage hit, then T6 checks existing Combo for +25 Blossoms and -5s cooldown; baseline +20, then applies Combo. That ordering means the first Q on an unmarked target does not get the existing-Combo refund.

mechanics.name: Heavy / Colorful Phoenix
mechanics.implementation: VernalHeavy grants 5 Blossoms on its hit. Colorful variants expose one, two or three hits; fixed +4 grants from the target-check chain no longer stop at 100, while the shared resource cap clips the balance. Read every timed action, not just damage rows, for full Blossom generation.

mechanics.name: Spring Away
mechanics.implementation: Editable channel hold capped at 10s, plus 0.74s startup and 0.5909090909090908s recovery. Endurance depletion ends channel early; launched projectiles survive recovery. Channel drains 10 Endurance/s before cost modifiers. Each projectile restores 3.4 Blossoms and has 25% PvE HP damage. It is Charged and FrequentProjectile, so Startling Spring and the selected projectile attunement can apply.

mechanics.name: Emerald Barrier
mechanics.implementation: Two sequential 15s charges shared by full/cancel. Damage at 0.15006s; Jadebreak at 0.167s. Full cast ends and grants Windrider at 1.02s; cancel ends at 0.167s without Windrider. Jadebreak gives Ballistic +30% plus another +10% to Ballistic OR Pursuit. These are additive Category 1 effects.

mechanics.name: Forsaken Fame
mechanics.implementation: One Fan charged-light hit at 1.19s, full cast 1.63s; applies LB and restores 10 Endurance. Intrinsic +45% HP damage is a modifier, not included in coefficients. Charged enables Startling Spring; applying LB enables Star Reacher through its damage trigger.

mechanics.name: Moon Shatter Spring
mechanics.implementation: Requires LB or Airborne; six-second cooldown. Windrider selects the five-hit branch at cast start; otherwise three hits. Nominal interrupt 2.433s / 1.557s. NPC +45% is already in the hit coefficients: do not add it again. Each hit adds Startling Spring. Exact per-branch actions and requirements are in the skill records.

mechanics.name: Peak’s Springless Silence
mechanics.implementation: Full 1.1133333333333333s; cancel 0.557581475s and must lead into pursuit. Preliminary contact at 0.35s is 0.5% of damage and requires distance <2.5 and not Airborne; main contact at 0.557581475s carries 99.5%. Existing LB/Airborne gates Windrider; LB grant is not equivalent to having a pre-existing mark. Shared twelve-second cooldown.

mechanics.name: Drunken Poet / Smolder
mechanics.implementation: Poet composite variants execute selected stages; Intoxicated gates their routes. Each strike can trigger its own Combustion or Smolder explosion. All are reported as Drunken Poet, including explosions. Fifth-hit enhancement consumes stacks and uses the authored modifier snapshot. Smolder hits, DOT ticks, and Poet explosions are distinct events. Cancel variants require the accepted follow-up.

mechanics.name: Flute / Ghostly Umbra / Dragon Head
mechanics.implementation: Flute damage bonus reads per-hit distance: 2% at 1m, 20% at 9–<20m. Ghostly Umbra damage boost and counterattack require successful dodge. Dragon Head - Tide uses eight authored Surging Waves stacks; during Exhausted they provide a separate base-damage multiplier as well as Category 1 damage. Its missing-HP bonus is hit-time; do not replace its enlightenment coefficients with regular Dragon Head.

mechanics.name: Build and encounter
mechanics.implementation: Short Fight = Rain Whisper + Breaking Point; Long Fight = Mistwillow + Thunderous Bloom. Both use Blossom Barrage, Morale Chant, Star Reacher. Max Short Fight uses one Precision and nine Crit rolls, retains Power, and tier100 All Mystic on helmet/chest. Rain Whisper grants +10% crit damage, plus +15% while Shield exists. 30s dummy has incoming paired attacks at 5.5+6n seconds; Qi is explicitly authored, not inferred from damage.

reviewQuestions.subject: Combo tier replacement versus addition
reviewQuestions.observed: The BT19 reference hit state contains hpDMGBonus 0.1 AND 0.2 for Ballistic on JadeCombo. The damage resolver adds both (30%).
reviewQuestions.review: Compare base Combo and Blossom Barrage T1/T6 source effects. Is the upgraded value 20% TOTAL or +20 percentage points? Do not assume modify.effect replaces the base array.

reviewQuestions.subject: Ordinary Star Reacher replacement versus addition
reviewQuestions.observed: The BT19 reference state contains physicalAttackBonus 0.05 AND 0.075 on StarReacherBone, giving 12.5% before other physical attack bonuses. Enhanced StarReacherBoneEnhanced carries 15%.
reviewQuestions.review: Verify whether T1 should replace 5% with 7.5%, rather than add it. Check shared effect-definition modifier semantics and source ownership.

reviewQuestions.subject: Star Reacher enhanced branches and T6 eligibility
reviewQuestions.observed: StarReacherGrant selects the same 15% enhanced buff for Exhausted OR Qi below 30%; the T6 3% damage rule uses LingeringBone OR Airborne plus HP >75%.
reviewQuestions.review: Compare raw source conditions for the exported 15%/25% wording and whether T6 requires LB AND Airborne rather than OR. Translation alone is insufficient.

reviewQuestions.subject: UF separate hits and resource feedback
reviewQuestions.observed: One / two / three separate damage actions for ordinary / LB / Airborne volleys. Each qualifying exhausted hit refunds 3 Blossoms. LB is refreshed once per volley after damage.
reviewQuestions.review: Separate hits and individual refunds were explicitly confirmed by the user on 2026-11-02. Verify per-hit event identity, any sub-hit timing, and which listeners have cooldowns; do not recombine multiplied coefficients.

reviewQuestions.subject: Spring Away Blossom Barrage T4 scope
reviewQuestions.observed: The current T4 damage/Combo-extension conditions explicitly require UnfadingFlowerProjectile. Spring Away uses SpringAwayProjectile.
reviewQuestions.review: The exported T4 text also mentions Spring Away. Verify raw conditions before extending the existing mechanism.

reviewQuestions.subject: Golden Body support is partial
reviewQuestions.observed: Zero-time cancel, delayed Shield application at +0.5s, ten-second Shield and twenty-second cooldown. No numerical absorption, shield break from incoming damage, Vitality cost, defensive bonuses or expiry healing.
reviewQuestions.review: Cancel/application timings are user-confirmed. Review shield survival assumptions for Rain Whisper; do not treat this as a full defensive implementation.

reviewQuestions.subject: Nominal timing and distance
reviewQuestions.observed: UF first callback +1.15s from activation start, then every 0.5s. Spring Away uses nominal projectile timing; Peak moves to 1m before its main hit in flying presets.
reviewQuestions.review: Distinguish cast/input, launch/request, collider opening and real impact. Travel and contact uncertainty is not eliminated by using the nominal export.

reviewQuestions.subject: Mystic enlightenment provenance
reviewQuestions.observed: Smolder, Dragon Head - Tide and Ghostly Umbra use established enlightenment routes; regular exported curves are not substitutes. Offensive Mystic coefficients use level 76.
reviewQuestions.review: Reconstruct each multiplier once. Preserve Smolder user-confirmed 0.0532 tick factor; investigate its conflict with exported 0.045 separately.

reviewQuestions.subject: Snapshot comparison and stale prose
reviewQuestions.observed: Older sections of skill-data.md describe the obsolete 60s IV preset, seven cycles, unavailable pursuit timing and old default builds.
reviewQuestions.review: Use current JSON and the reference runtime, not historical prose, as the implementation baseline. Screenshot 75 UF attempts and 117255 DPS are external observations with unknown complete gear/outcome state.

reviewQuestions.subject: Dodge semantics
reviewQuestions.observed: UF heavy has no projectile attunement. Soaring 0.5s, Phoenix/Fan Q 0.4s windows require incoming attacks. Overlap awards only latest active response; explicit Perfect Dodge/successful Deflect retain legacy no-attack fallback.
reviewQuestions.review: Verify window start/end boundaries, cancellation persistence, same-timestamp paired attacks and fallback semantics independently.
